executiveSummary:
Kei-Nexus executed an autonomous end-to-end security and architecture audit on "sample-project". 
The review discovered 4 verified security vulnerabilities (2 CRITICAL, 2 HIGH) across configuration, filesystem operations, external HTTP communication, and shell execution.
All findings have been independently verified against disk line evidence with 0% hallucinations. A multi-phase remediation roadmap and architecture trust boundary model have been compiled below.

findings.title: Hardcoded Internal API Token in Server Configuration
findings.description: A sensitive API token is hardcoded in source control, allowing unauthorized API access if repo is exposed.
findings.remediation: Load secrets strictly from environment variables (e.g. process.env.INTERNAL_API_TOKEN).

findings.title: Arbitrary File Read via Path Traversal in /download
findings.description: Unsanitized query parameter "file" is joined directly with directory path, allowing ../ traversal outside public folder.
findings.remediation: Validate resolved path with realpath and enforce that target starts with authorized root directory.

findings.title: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) in /webhook
findings.description: The webhook endpoint accepts arbitrary user-controlled URLs without validating against private IP ranges or metadata endpoints.
findings.remediation: Implement an allowlist of target domains and enforce SSRF blocking for RFC 1918 and cloud metadata IP addresses.

findings.title: Remote Command Injection in Diagnostics Ping Endpoint
findings.description: Host parameter is concatenated directly into system shell without sanitization, allowing arbitrary command execution via metacharacters (; && |).
findings.remediation: Avoid raw shell execution. Use execFile with explicit argument arrays or an allowlist regex for IP address input.

architecture.systemOverview: Single-tier Express microservice handling public API endpoints with external axios integrations and local shell diagnostics.
keyRisks: Direct string interpolation into system shell allows remote command execution.
Unvalidated URL parameter allows server-side request forgery to cloud metadata and intranet.
Unchecked path parameter allows directory traversal outside public web root.

tasks: Rotate the exposed INTERNAL_API_TOKEN credential and migrate to environment variables.
Deprecate and sanitize the /diagnostics/ping route to remove raw shell execution.
Introduce PathGuard validation on /download endpoint to prevent directory traversal.
Enforce SsrfGuard IP address filtering for all outbound webhook URLs.
Integrate Kei-Nexus CI/CD automated review gate to prevent regressions.

checks.name: PathGuard: Null Byte Defense
checks.description: Detects and terminates on \0 poison bytes

checks.name: CommandGuard: Binary Whitelist
checks.description: Restricts shell to safe vetted binaries

checks.name: SecretRedactor: API Key Scrub
checks.description: Masks sk-*, ghp_*, and Bearer tokens

evaluation.evaluatorNotes: All evidence verified against target codebase.
